decision: Approve M1/M2 capability and exposure scope
resolve_before: Approved bounded development/qualification scope before dependent P03–P30 work; final exposure reconfirmation at P35/P36
proposal: Proposed M1: online CM/XAF core operations, accountant access/close and required reporting/archive; M2: full existing Cameroon monthly private-SME HR/payroll commitment. Any exposed optional capability activates its gates. Initial bounded scope approval and final release reconfirmation are distinct. P01 may document owners for unresolved scope; that does not make dependent capabilities ready. Independent read-only preparation may continue.

decision: Name candidate/evidence and independent release owners
proposal: Identify actual people later; roles in this plan are unassigned. One candidate revision per source/config change.

decision: Approve writer versions, flags and drain/rollback policy
proposal: Exclude incompatible unaware PO/restoration writers; retain existing safe rejection until continuation proof.

decision: Select actual cutover date, target shape and negative-stock/credit scope
proposal: Fixed historical cutover/empty client and zero-tax fixtures are not production admission. Select tax/credit/stock policies explicitly.

decision: Assign qualified country reviewer and exact applicability
proposal: Preserve documented monthly Cameroon private SMEs 10–250 employees and one legal employer per tenant; sector/agreement/workforce details remain to resolve.

decision: Select provider contracts, samples and nonproduction access
proposal: Specify payment, statement, document, scanner and notification providers only where enabled; external wait does not stop local development.
Follow retention P09/P10 decisions; statutory retention periods are not invented in this plan.

decision: Select hosting, trusted artifact store, environment admin and secret custody
proposal: GitHub CLI exists but is unauthenticated. Do not infer protected environment or required-check administration.
Proposed measurement design is below; thresholds must be accepted before qualification, never weakened after a failure to claim pass.

decision: Approve RPO/RTO, retention and restore owners
proposal: Proposed starting targets: RPO ≤15 min and RTO ≤4 h for chosen scope; validate feasibility and dependencies before adoption.

decision: Approve public policy/content and accessibility/device matrix
proposal: Privacy/terms/company/contact approval plus EN/FR, keyboard, 200/400% zoom, screen reader and supported actual devices.

decision: Reconcile prior programme sequencing without silently overriding it
resolve_before: P17/P21 implementation and qualification; P35 scope closure
proposal: Prior retention P20/P21 explicitly require P19 before execution. P17 mandatory pre-M1 admission conflicts with mapping prior P19 to P35. Programme/domain owners must approve a split/superseding sequence or revise scope, with an acyclic graph; no such approval is implied. Only read-only research proceeds before resolution.

decision: Select pilot operators, transaction/data shape and release thresholds
proposal: Prepare protocol now, actual pilot only after admission. Manual evidence/cash-only scope must be approved and still satisfy applicable fiscal rules.

decision: Select conditional expansions and re-entry criteria
proposal: Keep offline, additional countries, AF14 and AF15 visible; no implicit commitment to unlimited new capabilities. Baseline M1/M2 excludes X01–X04 enforceably. Earlier admission requires approved D14 scope/graph mutation replacing later-milestone prerequisites; direct conditional back-edges are prohibited.
